verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a terminal, for example broadcasting input to many panes or acting on many sessions at once, but the evidence documents no such built-in capability. The AppleScript and Python APIs are developer building blocks a user could script bulk actions with. Global Search and Open Quickly search or navigate across sessions rather than operating on many items at once. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
